text: Which statement best represents the relationship among AI, ML and DL? A. ML is a subset of DL, and DL is a subset of AI. B. AI is a subset of ML, and ML is a subset of DL. C. ML is a subset of AI, and DL is a specialized subset of ML. D. AI, ML and DL are completely independent fields.

A machine-learning system is primarily different from traditional rule-based programming because it: A. always uses neural networks. B. learns patterns from data rather than relying only on explicitly written rules. C. does not require any data. D. can only solve classification problems.

Which of the following is a classification problem? A. Predicting next month's sales revenue. B. Predicting rainfall in millimetres. C. Predicting whether an email is spam or non-spam. D. Estimating the stock price for tomorrow.

Which task is most directly associated with clustering? A. Predicting a continuous numerical value. B. Grouping customers based on similar characteristics. C. Predicting whether a transaction is fraudulent. D. Converting speech into text.

In the basic ML workflow presented in the slides, what comes immediately after building the ML model? A. Collecting the experimental dataset. B. Making predictions on a new input/dataset. C. Removing all variables. D. Manually writing rules for every new observation.

A major distinguishing characteristic of deep learning is that it: A. always uses small datasets. B. requires manual feature extraction for every task. C. uses multiple neural-network layers to automatically learn features and patterns. D. can only process numerical data.
In a deep-learning network, which layer receives raw inputs such as image pixels or audio signals? A. Output layer B. Hidden layer C. Input layer D. Decision layer

What is the main role of backpropagation during deep-learning training? A. To collect new data. B. To adjust model weights by minimizing error. C. To convert text into another language. D. To group users into clusters.
Which neural-network architecture is especially associated with grid-like data such as images? A. RNN B. CNN C. LSTM D. ANN only
Which NLP technique breaks a sentence into words or other tokens? A. Tokenization B. Sentiment analysis C. Named Entity Recognition D. Translation
If an NLP system identifies 'Delhi', 'Google' and 'Monday' as entities in a sentence, which task is it performing? A. Text summarization B. NER C. Speech recognition D. Topic modeling
A system that converts spoken language into written text is performing: A. Text-to-Speech (TTS) B. Speech-to-Text (STT) C. Machine translation D. Sentiment analysis
A product-review system labels a review as positive, negative or neutral. This is an example of: A. Sentiment analysis B. Tokenization C. Clustering D. Regression

Which statement about GPUs is most consistent with the computational-power slides? A. GPUs are mainly designed for sequential, complex tasks. B. GPUs are effective for AI because they can perform many repetitive mathematical operations in parallel. C. GPUs eliminate the need for algorithms. D. GPUs are used only for data storage.

Which statement correctly distinguishes training from inference? A. Training uses a trained model for new inputs; inference adjusts parameters. B. Training repeatedly adjusts model parameters using data; inference uses the trained model to generate predictions or responses. C. Training and inference are exactly the same process. D. Inference always requires more computation than training.

Case 1: OTT Platform, Personalised Recommendations. An OTT platform has millions of users and thousands of movies and shows. A generic "Top Trending" list does not work equally well for all users. The platform wants to recommend content based on viewing history, ratings, searches, device type and time of use. It also wants to continuously test different recommendation approaches. 1.1 Identify whether the main prediction task is primarily classification, regression, clustering, or a combination of approaches. Explain your choice.
note: Section B marks are not stated.

text: Case 1 (OTT platform). 1.2 Which ML approaches from the slides could be used for personalised recommendations? Explain the role of collaborative filtering and content-based filtering.
Case 1 (OTT platform). 1.3 Explain how deep learning and A/B testing could contribute to improving the recommendation engine.

Case 2: Customer-Service Voice Assistant. A bank introduces a voice-based customer-service assistant. Customers speak in Hindi or English, ask questions about accounts and transactions, and expect the system to understand their intent and provide a relevant response. The bank also wants the system to identify important details such as dates, names and account-related entities. 2.1 Identify the major NLP tasks involved when the customer's spoken query is converted into text and understood by the system.
Case 2 (bank voice assistant). 2.2 Which NLP technique would help extract names, places, dates or organisations from the customer's message? Explain.
Case 2 (bank voice assistant). 2.3 Describe a simple end-to-end NLP workflow for this application, from receiving the customer's speech to generating a response.

Case 3: AI Project, Choosing Computational Infrastructure. A retail company plans to deploy an AI system that processes large amounts of customer data and generates recommendations for millions of users. During model development, the team needs substantial computational resources for repeated training. After deployment, the company needs fast and cost-efficient predictions. Management is deciding whether to buy GPUs, rent cloud computing capacity, or use an existing AI service. 3.1 Explain why computational power is important for this AI project, particularly during model training.
Case 3 (computational infrastructure). 3.2 Differentiate the roles of CPU and GPU for this type of workload. Why can GPUs be effective for AI workloads?

Case 3 (computational infrastructure). 3.3 As an MBA manager, identify three factors the company should consider before choosing between owned infrastructure, cloud computing and an existing AI service.
